title: The first install route pointed at a releases page with nothing on it
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader
details:
INSTALL.md §1 leads with "Download a release": fetch the archive and `checksums.txt`, verify the checksum, then the cosign signature. `gh release list` returns nothing, because no v* tag has been pushed and `.github/workflows/release.yml` fires on a tag.

A first-time reader takes the first route offered and finds an empty page.

Cutting the first tag makes the whole section true. Until then the page says so, which is what the tracer repository already does.
